vulnerability_summary: OpenClaw exposed unrestricted HTTP tool invocation and auto-approved ACP permission requests too broadly.
causality: Human commit f1083cd5 introduced /tools/invoke without a dangerous-tool deny boundary, and human commit 9809b47d introduced ACP's unconditional allow_once selection. Aether commit 0af37a09 was a hardening patch: it added a deny list and changed blanket ACP approval to approval of names outside a dangerous-name set. Later human commits tightened this still-incomplete mitigation. The AI patch reduced an already-existing exposure and did not atomically introduce either vulnerable surface.
